name: ILattice
doc: Lattice: join (LUB) + meet (GLB). The CRDT merge structure.

members.name: Join
members.doc: Least upper bound (⊔). Idempotent, commutative, associative.

members.name: Meet
members.doc: Greatest lower bound (⊓). Idempotent, commutative, associative.

laws: Join is idempotent: Join(a, a) = a
Join is commutative: Join(a, b) = Join(b, a)
Meet is idempotent: Meet(a, a) = a
Meet is commutative: Meet(a, b) = Meet(b, a)
Absorption: Join(a, Meet(a,b)) = a; Meet(a, Join(a,b)) = a
